prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 84.8%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 27.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Path Overview Preview Screen: Insert a dedicated preview screen before path selection that introduces preset versus custom pet creation visually. (why: choose_path has a high mean time of 514s and 80.2% conversion, showing users hesitate when picking their initial onboarding route.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Post-Onboarding Pet Control Guide: Add an interactive checklist tutorial screen at the end of onboarding explaining how to hide, summon, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted confusion on controlling or hiding the pet post-setup, and finish conversion is 71.7%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In Pre-Waiting Sync: Position the sign-in step directly after adoption certificate completion and before the waiting render step. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in; placing sign-in right before model generation binds pet data securely.)
3: [home, wait_info] Desktop Render Progress Bar: Display explicit system progress bar components and render time estimations on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop.)
4: [choose_path, layout] Split Comparison Path Choice: Change choose_path screen layout to split layout with visual side-by-side path comparisons. (why: choose_path has long average completion times (mean 514s), showing users need clearer contrast between choices.)
5: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Finalization Copy: Update adoption certificate copy to clarify desktop placement and instant activation. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 68.9%.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Launch Ready Notification Toggle: Enable desktop notification readiness alerts while the pet render process completes in the background. (why: Mean wait time is 2336s and 3 users reported app stalling or pets not showing up on launch.)
